HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — TERMLY EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.
   D. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.
   D. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

3. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Avoid saving forever

   D. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.

5. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Nakuru
   B. Nairobi
   C. Kisumu
   D. Mombasa

6. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

7. Which statement about Internal conflicts in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Internal conflicts in Africa.

   C. Say Internal conflicts in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Internal conflicts in Africa as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Human Developments in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Human Developments in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Human Developments in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Human Developments in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Human Developments in Africa.

9. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   B. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.
   D. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.

11. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   B. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Destroying road signs
   D. Avoiding all community work

13. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   B. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   C. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

14. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing National Security.
   C. Explain National Security with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat National Security as rumours only.

15. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   B. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   D. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Civilisations in South and Central Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   B. Explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Civilisations in South and Central Africa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Civilisations in South and Central Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Colonial Administration in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Political developments in independent Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Internal conflicts in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
